response.sql: WITH circuit_races AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuit_races) SELECT cr.circuitId, cr.race_count, 1.0 * cr.race_count / t.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 * cr.race_count / t.total_races - 1.0 / t.circuit_count AS share_above_average FROM circuit_races AS cr CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE cr.race_count * t.circuit_count > t.total_races ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, cr.circuitId LIMIT 10;
